findings.reason: The standalone original tiles contain no illustration. The proof hinges on a common color-to-state map and its compatibility with the WL and network updates, a concrete commuting square that materially clarifies the induction and the one-way expressivity bound. A generic square captures the actual shared interface more precisely than arbitrary sample graph panels.
findings.action: Added a four-object tikzcd square and exact map definitions in final Remarks, followed by its commuting relation and the multiset/readout consequence.

correction: Appended only explanatory Remarks defining occurring-color sets D_t and occurring neighborhood pairs P_t, the maps q_t,p_t,phi_t,F_{t+1}, and their commutative square; retained all pre-existing bytes.

diagram_math_checks.objects_and_maps: For 0 <= t < K, D_t consists of colors occurring in G or H; P_t consists of occurring pairs (center color, neighbor-color multiset). q_t:P_t -> D_{t+1} is the canonical ordered-pair WL update. phi_t:D_t -> H_t is well-defined by proof step 1.1.
diagram_math_checks.justification: The local WL definition uses C_{t+1}=C_t x M_fin(C_t), so q_t(c,M)=(c,M) is the exact next color; restricting to actual neighborhoods ensures its image lies in D_{t+1}.

diagram_math_checks.domains_and_codomains: p_t:P_t -> H_t x M_fin(H_t) maps the center by phi_t and each multiset occurrence by phi_t. F_{t+1}:H_t x M_fin(H_t) -> H_{t+1} is U_{t+1}(h,A_{t+1}(S)).
diagram_math_checks.justification: The local GNN definition gives A_{t+1}:M_fin(H_t)->Z_{t+1} and U_{t+1}:H_t x Z_{t+1}->H_{t+1}; every input to p_t uses colors in D_t.

diagram_math_checks.relation: The sole asserted commuting relation is phi_{t+1} composed with q_t = F_{t+1} composed with p_t on P_t. All horizontal arrows point right and vertical arrows point down.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Proof step 1.1 identifies phi_t(c) with the actual state for every occurrence; applying the shared aggregation and update to that neighborhood gives precisely the next state phi_{t+1}(q_t(c,M)). No injectivity or converse distinction statement is asserted.

diagram_math_checks.readout_and_proof_independence: Equal final color multisets map occurrence by occurrence to equal final-state multisets, then the same R gives equal outputs.
diagram_math_checks.justification: This is exactly step 2.1 and Facts F3/F4. Neither numbered proof step was edited; Remarks explicitly state that the proof is independent of the square.
